sn6.11:1.1: Evaṃ me sutam ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Sappinī-tīre || || Atha kho brahmā Sanaṃkumāro abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ Sappinī-tīram obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho brahmā Sanaṃkumāro Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn6.11:2.1: Khattiyo seṭṭho jane tasmiṃ || ye gottapaṭisārino || vijjācaraṇasampanno || so seṭṭho devamānuse ti || ||
sn6.11:3.1: Idam avoca brahmā Sanaṃkumāro || samanuñño satthā ahosi || || Atha kho brahmā Sanaṃkumāro samanuñño me satthā ti Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || ||
